notes.title: Bug Fixes & Patches!
notes.notes:
Thank you for waiting on the fixes peeps! Means the world to us you are playing the game! We have done a number of bug fixes for the game so it should be more stable now. As this is a port to steam a lot of stuff changes on the change over.

Keep us updated with bugs you find or stop by our Discord to let us know and dont forget to leave a review! These help us greatly!!!
